nodes.scope: Derive frequency separation, construct bumps and prove the exact initial gap
nodes.progress: From an exponential Riesz basis on a bounded measurable Euclidean domain, construct separated frequencies, a normalized compact nonnegative smooth bump with uniform positive Fourier lower bound, isometric translated-bump synthesis and an orthogonal projection at norm distance less than one from the Fourier projection.

nodes.scope: Compact metrizable configuration space with jointly continuous real translations
nodes.progress: A compact metrizable space of closed separated configurations, including the empty set, is constructed. Its sequential convergence is equivalent to the exact Beurling local matching definition, and real translations act jointly continuously. Sequential extraction uses compatible Hausdorff limits on compact Euclidean windows; metrizability uses extended-distance probes on a countable dense set. This replaces the counting-measure extraction proof of the same hull lemma; equivalence with vague convergence is not claimed by this node.

nodes.scope: Strong continuity of bump projections and the uniform gap on the actual hull
nodes.progress: Actual synthesis projections converge strongly under Beurling weak limits. Translation covariance preserves the actual Fourier/bump gap on the orbit; strong closure propagates the same bound throughout the hull. From a measurable bounded domain and its actual exponential Riesz basis, the implementation constructs the normalized Schwartz bump and one uniform gap strictly below one on the entire translation hull.

nodes.scope: Equivalence with vague counting-measure convergence; invariant probability measure from continuous boxes; strongly continuous Koopman action
nodes.progress: The compact translation hull carries an invariant Borel probability measure, constructed from actual continuous Euclidean box averages. Coordinate-box volumes and positive normalized averaging functionals are proved. Symmetric differences lie in fixed-thickness shells whose relative volumes tend to zero; change of variables and an integral bound give vanishing translation error. Banach-Alaoglu and Riesz-Markov-Kakutani then give the invariant probability measure, both for general continuous Euclidean actions and specifically for the paper hull. The Koopman operators are constructed with the manuscript convention U_z f(Γ)=f(Γ+z), hence pullback by T_{-z}. They are unitaries, obey the additive group law, and form a strongly continuous representation on the separable stationary L² space. Constants are invariant and the constant one has norm one. Finite injective point matching controls compactly supported test integrals. Weak convergence therefore implies vague convergence. A compactly supported bump distinguishes different configurations, so the continuous counting-test map is injective; compactness makes it an embedding and proves the converse. All mathematical components compile and pass all 15 linters.

nodes.scope: Finite Euclidean scalar spectral measures with uniqueness
nodes.progress: Actual hull correlations are continuous and positive definite, with the value at zero equal to the squared vector norm. Representing measures are unique and have the required mass. Existence is proved for scalar correlations of strongly continuous unitary representations on separable complex Hilbert spaces: normalized vector windows in the original Hilbert space are expanded in a countable Hilbert basis, their scalar coordinates have explicit physical Fourier-density measures, and a bounded vague cluster limit represents the original correlation. Measures are chosen for every vector and specialized to the stationary hull Koopman representation. This is the exact Bochner existence used in the manuscript; it does not claim the theorem for every abstract positive-definite function.

nodes.scope: Control measure, Dirac constant spectrum, and L¹ integrated filter calculus
nodes.progress: The invariant unit constant is represented by the Dirac measure at zero. Addition, scaling and uniqueness give the spectral parallelogram and homogeneity identities. Integrated L¹ operators have the required norm, adjoint, convolution and Fourier-symbol formulas. A dense unit sequence and dyadic weights construct one probability control measure dominating every vector spectral measure. The proved unitary spectral-measure family supplies all representing measures used by this calculus. Ordinary physical translations are also diagonalized directly, with density |paperFourierL2 f|², zero mass at the origin and no nonzero invariant vector in positive dimension.

nodes.scope: Positive continuous-box kernels and approximate-identity convergence
nodes.progress: The full continuous Euclidean Fejér construction is proved. Product weights are exactly the normalized actual translated-box overlaps, including in dimension zero. They are nonnegative, at most one, compactly supported, and converge to one. Actual positive-sign Plancherel proves that the box Fourier kernel is nonnegative, integrable and has mass one. Euclidean dilation proves its exact scaling and vanishing tails. The smoothed indicators lie between zero and one and converge to the domain indicator off its frontier. The normalized autocorrelation identity and Fourier transposition prove both the Fourier transform of the weight and the exact w_R times domain-kernel coefficient formula. No Bochner assumption is used.

nodes.scope: Construct good-parameter projections and prove scalar norm identities
nodes.progress: The actual finite filters converge strongly as real R tends to infinity to a simultaneous family of self-adjoint idempotent contractions on a measurable conull parameter set. Spectral mass and two-parameter difference identities are proved. The unitary spectral-measure theorem and the common control measure discharge the representation and domination inputs.

nodes.scope: Construct the actual M_t and prove idempotence, self-adjointness and norm Lipschitz continuity
nodes.progress: The actual kernel is jointly continuous in the configuration and both spatial variables. L² multiplication and Koopman shifts construct the strongly continuous integrand, with an integrable compact envelope and first moment. The actual M_t integral is norm-Lipschitz and self-adjoint. Normalized kernel reproduction, continuous coefficient integration, product integrability, Fubini and the convolution-coordinate change prove actual idempotence.

nodes.scope: Actual scalar averaged forms, measurable representatives and transfer of the same gap
nodes.progress: Canonical scalar tests are actual FullL2 classes on almost every hull fiber, with jointly measurable representatives, integrable scalar norm fields and exact averaged energy. Actual Fourier and bump projection pairings and scalar Cauchy–Schwarz transfer the uniform hull gap to the finite operators; strong cutoff limits and norm convergence of comparison averages transfer it to the actual good-parameter family. The stationary spectral-measure theorem supplies the required measures.

nodes.scope: Literal Hausdorff sphere measure: mass, nullity and nonzero translated overlaps
nodes.progress: The literal codimension-one Hausdorff restriction to every positive-radius sphere in d≥2 is finite, nonzero, supported on the sphere and has zero measure on every nonzero translated sphere intersection. Two bounded stereographic charts give finiteness, tangent projection gives positivity, and isometric reduction to a sphere in the bisecting hyperplane gives overlap nullity. The sphere is Lebesgue null.

nodes.scope: Choose one clean point and construct the strictly included cutoff ranges
nodes.progress: Fubini selects a clean point for the common control measure. Actual cutoff symbols converge along conull sequences through both ambient open sides. Spectral difference identities construct orthogonal strong limits with ordered norms; the invariant Dirac vector witnesses strict inclusion. The generalized full jump set retains all tangential frequencies along an edge. The sphere and planar contradictions are assembled, with spectral existence supplied by the proved stationary family.

nodes.scope: Unconditional nonexistence for every d ≥ 2 and every positive-radius ball
nodes.progress: The actual exponential Riesz basis supplies its separated hull, normalized bump and strict uniform gap; an invariant probability measure is constructed. The proved stationary spectral family yields the control measure, cutoff family and averaged gap. Literal sphere geometry and the invariant Dirac vector give the contradiction. The unconditional wrapper excludes every positive-radius ball in dimension at least two.

nodes.scope: Nonexistence under the literal boundary-measure criterion
nodes.progress: The exact manuscript hypotheses are retained: a nonempty bounded open domain with null frontier, a finite nonzero supported boundary measure with null nontrivial translated overlaps, and positive-volume access to both open sides in every neighborhood almost everywhere. Tonelli selects a clean two-sided point. The proved stationary spectral family completes the basis-to-hull-to-cutoff construction, giving unconditional nonexistence without extra boundary regularity.

nodes.scope: Translated edge nullity and same-normal-direction crossing
nodes.progress: Literal Hausdorff edge-length measures are finite and positive, and translated transverse supporting lines have zero edge measure. Actual triangle and finite-halfspace polygon geometry gives local same-direction crossing, clean face points and conull two-sided approaches. Odd-cardinality extraction derives an unpaired supporting direction and proves at most two sides per unoriented direction. Interval endpoints and opposite rectangle edges provide the concrete positive-overlap counterexamples from the explanatory remark. All modules in the combined project build with warnings as errors.

nodes.scope: Nonexistence for every noncollinear planar triangle and arbitrary frequencies
nodes.progress: The actual full tangential edge jump gives the standard triangle contradiction. An invertible map built from independent vertex edges identifies the positive-barycentric triangle with the affine image of the standard triangle. Affine basis transport and the proved stationary spectral family yield unconditional nonexistence for every noncollinear triple and every frequency set.

nodes.scope: Unpaired maximal edges and odd-sided convex polygons with explicit geometric representation
nodes.progress: Actual finite-halfspace polygons with an unpaired face or odd side count satisfy the full-jump cutoff and comparison contradiction. Literal nondegenerate maximal boundary segments are exactly the closed supporting faces; strict faces are their open segments, the frontier is their union, and geometric side parallelism agrees with normal parallelism. Positive normalization removes unit-normal assumptions. The proved stationary spectral family yields the unconditional unpaired-maximal-side and odd-maximal-side conclusions.

authorized_external_results.name: Titchmarsh–Lions convolution support theorem
authorized_external_results.statement: For nonzero compactly supported distributions, the convex hull of the support of their convolution is the Minkowski sum of the convex hulls of their supports.
authorized_external_results.authorization: Explicit author instruction on 2026-09-26: you can assume titchmark thm
authorized_external_results.encoding: Explicit theorem hypothesis; no added Lean axiom.

alternative_proof_notes.formalized_substitute: The ball transform is derived from its actual integral and Gamma moments. Radial ODE energy identities classify every complex zero and prove simple local quadric factors. These replace the uses of the infinite product in membership and division.

Existence of a maximal-volume inscribed ellipsoid and affine normalization are proved. Translation rigidity follows directly from maximality by capsule enlargement; general uniqueness of the John ellipsoid is not needed or claimed.
